excerpt.zh: 随着我们收集到更多有关[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的资料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人和我们对于整个星系具有大量相同的看法。
excerpt.en: As we have gathered more material on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share much of our outlook on the galaxy as a whole.

texts.zh: 随着我们收集到更多有关[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的资料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人和我们对于整个星系具有大量相同的看法。
texts.en: As we have gathered more material on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share much of our outlook on the galaxy as a whole.

texts.zh: 随着我们在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]取得更多的材料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人与我们具有非常相似的思维模式。或许他们的意识与我们的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]是相似的。
texts.en: As we have gathered more material on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share very similar thought patterns to our own. Perhaps their consciousness is alike to our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]?

texts.zh: 随着我们在[This.ContactCountry.GetName]取得更多的材料，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]非常惊讶于进展速度是如此之快。似乎——如果他们是对的话——这些外星人和我们具有非常相似的执行逻辑。或许在这些信号之后的人工智能与我们的[This.Owner.GetGovernmentName]非常相似？
texts.en: As we have gathered more material on the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] have been surprised at the fast pace of their progress. It seems that - if they are right - these aliens share a very similar execution logic to our own. Perhaps an AI much like our own [This.Owner.GetGovernmentName] lies behind these signals?

label.zh: 这对我们之间未来的关系是一个好的预示。
label.en: This bodes well for our future relations with them.
